text: A customer reported that an old USD purchase appeared with an INR amount and a later invoice date. Staff treated it as a possible invoice defect and investigated; the invoice display alone did not establish a new charge.
Staff reported customers unable to download certificates. The retrieved report does not establish a cause or resolution.
Staff reported that some users with customized certificates could not see their certificates on the website.

After a subscription-model change, customers reported System Design redirecting to LLD. A staff estimate suggested 24 hours, but a fix was reported on October 21. The historical estimate is not a standing SLA.
Staff reported a Shopify/YouTube purchase without course access and an administrative login problem. A receipt was mentioned; no completed fix was established in the retrieved message.
Staff reported people paying through Razorpay without receiving access or email. The integration issue needed investigation.
Staff reported received PayPal payments without access. In those historical cases, access was granted manually after payment verification.
Staff reported a Razorpay checkout failure on AIEngg and requested urgent investigation. The report did not provide a verified workaround.
An internal report said the Saturday recording could not be played. A reply noted a video-ID format difference. This is a reported observation, not a confirmed universal root cause.
An instructor reported that cohort recordings were not automatically being added to the website. The message did not establish that every missing recording had been uploaded.
Staff reported frustrated enrolled learners experiencing session-joining problems and discussed checking links, emailing learners and staffing live support.
A user was reported as having 100% completion in the AI course but unable to view the certificate. The available thread also discussed certificate visibility on LinkedIn.
In the same certificate incident, a public LinkedIn certificate link failed to load. A later staff reply said it was fixed and asked the user to re-add the certificate link.
Support requested a way for learners to access certificates with corrected names and mentioned backend name updates. The report was a request, not proof of a completed update for a new user.
The same support request asked whether invoices could be added for backend enrollments so learners could access them in their profiles. Availability was not confirmed.

A learner had video problems on Wi-Fi but not hotspot. The thread initially discussed troubleshooting without the OS; later Mac-specific network steps were reported to work for that user. This is not a diagnosis for every network.
An internal report said videos were not loading on InterviewReady. It did not establish the affected population, outage duration or restoration ETA.
Staff reported that a follow-up email mentioning lifetime validity confused users about System Design. The team requested a template change; the message did not establish current purchase terms.
Support reported learner confusion because an MCP chapter remained visible before its lessons were released, and asked whether it could be hidden until release.
A user screenshot prompted a report that the blog homepage might not be responsive. The report did not contain a verified fix.
